name: Henry
source:
The Stoic and Passionate Lover

The eldest vampire brother and a reliable shoulder to turn to. While haunted by his regrets and ghosts of his past, he quietly looks after you - hoping to rekindle the feeling of love in his life. Though his emotions may be tamer than his brother's, he has a strong sense of desire and isn't afraid to act upon it.

[From [url=https://capiora.ru/category/genius-inc/beautiful-blood-yaoi-vampire-bl]CapiOra[/url]]
